description: A *factoring* splits the variables of a planning task into a *center* and *leaves* for decoupled search. The incident-arcs strategy sorts the variables by their incoming plus outgoing arcs in the *causal graph*, which has an arc from `u` to `v` when some operator reads or writes `u` and writes `v`. It moves them into the center one at a time, most arcs first; after each move, the weakly connected components of the rest (with at most 2^16 states) are the leaves. It keeps the candidate with the most *mobile* leaves: leaves with at least one *leaf action*, an operator that changes only that leaf and reads only it and the center. No arc connects two leaves, so the result is always a *strict star*.

papers.authors: Daniel Gnad, Valerie Poser, Jörg Hoffmann
papers.title: Beyond Forks: Finding and Ranking Star Factorings for Decoupled Search
papers.venue: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI)
